questions.question:
**Directions: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The visitors complained / at the poor accommodation / they were provided / during the tour.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**at the poor accommodation**' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the use of the preposition 'at' is incorrect.
 
• The preposition 'at' is used **for expressing location or arrival in a particular place or position**.
 
• The use of the word 'complained' in the sentence indicates **to say that someone is not satisfied with or happy about something**.
 
• Therefore, the preposition 'about' should be used in place of the preposition 'at'.
 
• The preposition 'about' means '**on the subject of; concerning '**.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct Sentence: *The visitors complained **about the poor accommodation** they were provided during the tour*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिए गए वाक्य में preposition 'at' का प्रयोग गलत है।
 
• Preposition 'at' का अर्थ है **पर, में (स्‍थान का संदर्भ)**।
 
• वाक्य में 'complained' शब्द का प्रयोग, **किसी बात से असंतोष व्‍यक्त करना; शिकायत करने का संकेत** देता है।
 
• इसलिए, preposition 'about' का प्रयोग preposition 'at' के स्थान पर किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• Preposition 'about' का अर्थ है **के विषय में, के बारे में, के संबंध में**।

 

अतः सही उत्तर option 2 है।

सही वाक्य: *The visitors complained about the poor accommodation they were provided during the tour*.

questions.question:
**Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. The festival is named after the Indian Hornbill.

B. The Hornbill festival is the most anticipated cultural carnival of this state.

C. Located in Northeast India, Nagaland is a very beautiful and ethnically diverse state.

D. The Hornbill is often displayed on the traditional tribal headgears worn during Naga festivities.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'CBAD.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence 'C' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "the state - Nagaland". Hence, 'C' is the first part.
 
• Sentence B will come after C as it is talking about the most anticipated cultural carnival of Nagaland.
 
• Sentence A will come after B as it is giving information about how this festival got its name.
 
• The sentence 'D' is the concluding part because **it is giving information about how and where the hornbill is displayed**.

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *Located in Northeast India, Nagaland is a very beautiful and ethnically diverse state. The Hornbill festival is the most anticipated cultural carnival of this state. The festival is named after the Indian Hornbill. The Hornbill is often displayed on the traditional tribal headgears worn during Naga festivities.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

 __
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• वाक्य 'C' किसी अन्य वाक्य से स्वतंत्र है क्योंकि यह "राज्य - नागालैंड" के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी दे रहा है। अतः 'C' पहला भाग है।
 
• वाक्य B, C के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह नागालैंड के सबसे प्रत्याशित सांस्कृतिक कार्निवल के बारे में बात कर रहा है।
 
• वाक्य **A**, B के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह इस बात की जानकारी दे रहा है कि इस त्योहार का नाम कैसे पड़ा।
 
• वाक्य 'D' समापन भाग है क्योंकि यह जानकारी दे रहा है कि हॉर्नबिल कैसे और कहाँ प्रदर्शित किया जाता है।

__
 
• The given word 'Fallacy' means **a false belief or a wrong idea**. (झूठा विश्‍वास या भ्रांत धारणा)

 
 
• Example: *I thought she really loved me, but it was all my **fallacy***.

• Example: *They **cheat** and steal from each other*.
 
 
 
• 'Flaw' means **a mistake in something that makes it not good enough, or means that it does not function as it should**. (दोष, त्रुटि, कमी, अभाव)
 
 
• Example: *The **flaw** in the system should be addressed*.
 
 
 
• 'Trick' means **something that you do to make somebody believe something that is not true or a joke that you play to annoy somebody**. (चाल, दाँव-पेंच)
 
 
• Example: *For his last **trick**, the magician made a rabbit disappear*.
 
 
 
• 'Truth' means **the state or quality of being true**. (सत्‍यता, सच्‍चाई, असलियत, वास्‍तविकता)
 
 
• Example: *He told the **truth** to the police*.

• The synonyms of the word 'Fallacy' are "**falsehood, falsity, untruth**".

questions.question:
**Directions: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The weather / is much / more warmer / than it was a few days before.

options.text: than it was a few days before

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**more warmer**' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the use of the determiner 'more' is superfluous or not required.
 
• **Double comparatives** (more and warmer) are **not used in a single sentence**.
 
• The use of '**than**' in the given sentence **indicates a comparison**.
 
• ‘**Much**’ is mainly used **with** **uncountable nouns** (here, **weather**).
 
• Therefore, the determiner 'more' should be eliminated.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct Sentence: *The weather is much **warmer** than it was a few days before*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिए गए वाक्य में determiner 'more' का प्रयोग अतिश्योक्तिपूर्ण है या आवश्यक नहीं है।
 
• **एक वाक्य में** **दो तुलनात्मक** (more and warmer) का **उपयोग नहीं किया जाता है**।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में 'than' का प्रयोग तुलना को दर्शाता है।
 
• ‘Much’ मुख्य रूप से uncountable nouns (यहाँ, weather) के साथ प्रयोग किया जाता है।
 
• इसलिए, determiner 'more' को समाप्त किया जाना चाहिए।

 

अतः सही उत्तर option 4 है।

सही वाक्य: *The weather is much warmer than it was a few days before*.

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

I am paid weekly by my organisation.

options.text: My organisation will pay me weekly.
My organisation would pay me weekly.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**My organisation pays me weekly**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice and it is in the present simple tense.
 
• When we convert this sentence into an active voice, the subject 'I' of the passive voice becomes the object 'me', the object 'my organisation' becomes the subject.
 
• The passive format "am + V3 (paid)" should be converted into the active format "V1 (pays)".
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the present simple tense.

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• Active Voice में, एक वाक्य विषय पर जोर देता है, एक क्रिया करता है।
 
• Passive Voice में, एक वाक्य वाक्य की क्रिया या वस्तु पर जोर देता है।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य passive voice में है और यह present simple tense में है।
 
• जब हम इस वाक्य को active voice में बदलते हैं, तो passive voice का subject 'I', object 'me' बन जाता है और object 'my organisation', subject बन जाता है।
 
• Passive format "am + V3 (paid)" को active format "V1 (pays)" में परिवर्तित किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• यह present simple tense के लिए active and passive voice rule है।

 

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

• दिया गया वाक्य "*Not only did they use fire to keep warm and cook their food; they also learned to use it in hunting or warfare, to kill insects, to safeguard berries, and to clear forests of underbrush so that game ___(5)___ be better seen and hunted*.'' खेल या भोजन के लिए शिकार किए गए जंगली स्तनधारियों या पक्षियों की स्पष्ट दृष्टि के बारे में बात करता है।
 
• आइए दिए गए विकल्पों का पता लगाएं:
 
 
• 'Shall' का अर्थ है **किसी बात के अवश्‍य या निश्चित रूप से घटित होने की सूचना देने वाली क्रिया, अनिवार्यता या निश्‍चय सूचक क्रिया**।
 
• 'Will' का अर्थ है **भविष्य के बारे में एक मजबूत इरादा या दावा व्यक्त करना**।
 
• 'Must' का अर्थ है **किसी बात के घटित होने की आवश्‍यकता बताने के लिए प्रयुक्त, आवश्‍यकता-बोधक, आवश्‍यकता का भाव व्‍यक्त करने के लिए प्रयुक्त**।
 
• 'Could' का अर्थ है **संभावना व्‍यक्त करने के लिए प्रयुक्त**।

 
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

पुरा वाक्य: *Not only did they use fire to keep warm and cook their food; they also learned to use it in hunting or warfare, to kill insects, to safeguard berries, and to clear forests of underbrush so that game could be better seen and hunted*.
